title.heading: Larkmoor College
title.subheading: A fictional college website with a program finder, faculty directory, admissions, campus map, athletics, news, events and a student and faculty portal.

end.heading: Built with Raytha
end.subheading: Open-source .NET CMS. Get the brief, screenshots and a one-command rebuild kit.

scenes.caption: A college home page with a program finder up front
Programs across six schools, filtered by school and degree
A faculty directory searchable by name, school and interest
An illustrated campus map with every building
Signed out, the portal asks students and faculty to sign in
Signed in, faculty see teaching and policy materials

phoneCaption.text: Every page works on a phone
